* Illustrated dimensions and targets are not homologated specifications. Confirm structural limits, vehicle range, speeds, loading, battery, safety and regulatory approval before ordering.

Can I purchase Bravos Truck now?

The Bravos Truck is presented as a concept-stage vehicle. Please enquire about development, prototype testing, confirmed options and manufacturing availability.

Is the 2.5–3 ton capacity certified?

No. The 2.5–3 ton payload is a figure shown on the supplied concept artwork. It requires structural, braking, powertrain and regulatory validation.

Will it travel 100–150 km per charge?

The reference image cites an approximate 100–150 km target range. Actual range, battery specification and performance are not verified and would depend on load, terrain, driving cycle and testing.

Does the solar roof charge the truck?

An approximately 800 W optional solar roof is illustrated in the design. Its final architecture, availability and actual energy contribution remain subject to validation.
